zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 长截图更顺畅，萤火守护员亮相
changes: 改进长截图的快速上下滚动拼接、超长图预览与完成时的内存占用；出现无法匹配时可继续捕获或保存已拼接部分
历史截图可标记保留，跳过自动数量和期限清理；多张贴图时可获得一次性工作区保存提醒
步骤文档可选择启用本地崩溃恢复；关闭未保存的短录屏预览前会请求确认
新 App 图标、官网中英文首屏和社交分享图统一为萤火守护员视觉形象，并修正短录屏能力说明
应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: Smoother scrolling captures meet the firefly guardian
changes: Improves fast upward and downward stitching, long-image previews, and memory use when finishing a capture; unmatched content can be retried or the stitched portion saved.
Keep selected history captures outside automatic count and age cleanup; a one-time reminder helps save a workspace with multiple pins.
Optional local crash recovery protects unfinished step guides; closing an unsaved short recording now asks for confirmation.
The new app icon, Chinese and English landing pages, and social preview share the firefly guardian design; the website also corrects its short-recording description.
The app and DMG are Apple-notarized, and the Sparkle update package is signed.
